status.description: What this agent did, not what it read about. 'summarized' means the report was produced -- a clear account of a failed compilation is a summarized result, and whether the underlying work succeeded is `succeeded`. Reserve the other two for not being able to summarize at all: the record was missing, unreadable, or never written. The fields 'summarized' owes are declared in `status_requires`.

run_id.description: Session run id, passed verbatim. Optional, but pattern-checked when present so a malformed id fails here rather than resolving to the wrong artifact root.

succeeded.description: Did the work being summarized succeed? Owed by a 'summarized' result. Deliberately separate from `status`, which is about this agent: compilation failing, a check failing and a sweep finding nothing are all `succeeded: false` inside a perfectly successful summary.

summary.description: The report itself, as the caller should read it -- markdown is fine, and it is one JSON string however many lines it runs to. Owed by a 'summarized' result: it is the deliverable, and these agents exist to produce prose for a human rather than fields for a program.

summary_artifact.description: Path to the report on disk. Owed only when the request carried an `output_path`, which is a condition this validator cannot express -- the instructions carry it instead.

failure_reason.description: The cause, on the axis the status enum deliberately does not cover. Why this agent could not summarize -- not why the summarized work failed, which belongs in `summary`.

error_message.description: Why the stage did not reach 'summarized'.

examples.summary: Entry point `flash_fwd_kernel`: FlashAttention-2 forward, one block per (batch, head, query tile). 4 ALGORITHMIC, 3 STRUCTURAL, 5 NON_PORTABLE items; the key ALGORITHMIC idea is the online softmax that never materializes the full score matrix. No base.py and nothing outside ref/ was written.
